PROJ-404.title: Fix memory leak in user authentication
PROJ-404.description: Users report sessions hanging. The listener isn't clearing cache keys.
PROJ-404.acceptance_criteria: Cache must clear upon socket close without failing.

PROJ-505.title: Add dark mode toggle
PROJ-505.description: Users want a way to switch the UI to a dark theme for nighttime viewing.
PROJ-505.acceptance_criteria: Toggle appears in the header. Selection saves to local storage.
